name: Flappy Bird
what: Tap to flap through gaps. Simple and very hard.
lovedFeatures: Tap or press a key to flap
Gaps to fly through that keep coming
One hit and it is game over
High score saved on your device
scopeNote: The best first game ever. You can have it working in under an hour.
legalNote: Don't use the name 'Flappy', the bird or the green pipes. Make your own hero and obstacles.
